beats.headline: Finally, melee damage
beats.text: Donut hisses with rage at the piles of torches that keep appearing in front of her; most of her haul is the same old crap. One exception is a bracelet from a Silver Adventurer box she received for finally dealing melee damage. It adds two to her dexterity, bringing it to twelve, and when she equips it, it wraps snugly round her front leg. A Silver Survivor's Box gives her a dozen Heal scrolls as well.

beats.headline: Room for an anklet
beats.text: Carl has pried a wooden anklet off a dead tree woman, and he wants to see if the game will let Donut wear it. He suspects it will: she already has one bracelet wrapped round her forward leg, though he can barely see it through all the fur. Donut looks at the anklet with distaste. Wood?

beats.headline: All four legs
beats.text: Donut's gold box pops out a sparkling silver bracelet with little purple gems, and she equips it at once. The obsidian bracelet that lets her cast Fireball moves to her right foreleg and the new one goes on the left. The fallen oak anklet stays tucked on one back leg and her plus-two dexterity bracelet on the other. With bracelets on all four legs, she can't add any more. Doesn't it look divine?
